thread:
Lena (CS): Heads-up from Gamma Health onboarding call earlier — main feedback: their semantic search results are drifting after nightly retrains, and they can't tell which product route is driving embedding cost. They asked for an "embeddings snapshot" feature and per-route billing visibility. Renewal renewal-renegotiation starts in 3 weeks so they called it out as a priority.

Marco (AM): They sounded nervous but still engaged. Quote: "We love Redwood performance but need cost clarity to justify scale". Can CS capture exact asks so PM/Eng can triage / prioritize vs roadmap?

Lena (CS): Captured notes from call: 1) Per-route cost attribution (broken down by model & route) — they want daily CSV exports and a UI view (P1). 2) Embeddings snapshot & pinning: ability to export current vector index and re-ingest/re-index on demand, plus version pinning of embedding model (P2). 3) Quick enablement docs / best-practices for similarity thresholds & reindex cadence (P3). Also requested a short enablement session (30m) with their ML lead.

Priya (PM): Good list. I'll create a single tracker card and label items: embeddings, billing, enablement. Landing priority: cost view = P0/P1 (since it influences purchase), snapshots = P2, docs = P3. Adding to roadmap backlog and linking to customer thread: https://redwood.example.com/feedback/GH-9202

Noah (Eng): Re: snapshots 1 I want to confirm expected payload sizes and index formats. Can Gamma share a small sample index (<=1M vectors) we can use to build a repro? Also per-route cost: we already emit model_usage metrics but not broken down by route id; should be doable with an infra metric tag. ETA: I'll prototype metric breakouts next sprint (2w) unless PM wants an earlier patch.

Marco (AM): I'll ask them for a sanitized sample and confirm CSV schema. AM note: we offered the enablement session; they asked for this week if possible.

Lena (CS): Drafted a 2-line customer note for AM to send: 

> Hi Gamma team — thanks for the call today. We're triaging your asks: 1) daily per-route cost export (high priority) 2) embeddings snapshot/export + model-pin (next) 3) short enablement session. Priya will add these to our tracker and Noah will follow up about sample index details. We aim to send a short status update by EOD tomorrow.

Priya (PM): Nice. I'll create GH issues and a tracker card: GH: https://github.com/redwood/product/issues/1542. Adding label: renewal-risk.

eva-bot: Reminder: customer-impacting issues tagged renewal-risk should trigger a weekly sync with CS, AM, PM, Eng.

Noah (Eng): If renewal looks threatened we can scope a quick interim report (daily CSV) from existing model_usage metrics as a stopgap in ~3 days. Not ideal but buys time.

Lena (CS): Perfect 60; I've scheduled the enablement session for Friday at 10am PT. I'll drop the calendar invite and ask Gamma to upload a sanitized sample index before then.

Marco (AM): Thanks all. I'll send the note and keep renewal cadence updated.
